module: Photo mode flash settings. Keeps the flash state in memory (enabled, fire on capture, intensity, angle, hue, saturation) and passes it to the util/photomodeFlash extension, which it loads on demand. Acts as a facade for the photo mode UI panel and for the capture module (ui_photomode_capture) which triggers captures with flash.
notes: Default values: enabled=false, fireOnCapture=false, intensity=25000, outerAngle=55, hue=0, saturation=0.
applyStatePatch only changes the Lua state; applyRuntimeSettings (or applyPresetState) must be called for util/photomodeFlash to actually be updated. Numeric values are not validated.
Functions that fail return false plus a reason: extensions_unavailable, flash_unavailable, flash_apply_failed, screenshot_request_failed.
getCaptureUiHoldFrames is 5 only if the flash is enabled and fires on capture, otherwise 0.

buildState.desc: Returns a copy of the flash state: enabled, fireOnCapture, intensity, outerAngle, hue, saturation.

capturePresetState.desc: Flash state to save in a preset (same as buildState).

captureDefaultPresetState.desc: Returns a flash state with default values, without modifying the current state.

applyStatePatch.desc: Merges into the state the fields present in partialState (enabled and fireOnCapture converted to booleans). Does not act on the render engine.

partialState.desc: Fields to change; any other type is ignored

applyPresetState.desc: Applies a preset state (merge then applyRuntimeSettings). Does nothing if the argument is not a table.

applyRuntimeSettings.desc: If the flash is disabled, turns off util/photomodeFlash (enable(false)). Otherwise loads this extension and calls applyFromUi with the current settings.

runCapture.desc: Delegates a capture to util/photomodeFlash.runCapture(kind, ...) with the call protected by pcall.

kind.desc: Capture type passed as is to util/photomodeFlash (inferred from code)

returns.desc: true if the capture was requested

getCaptureUiHoldFrames.desc: Number of frames during which to keep the UI hidden/frozen during a capture with flash: 5 if flash enabled and fireOnCapture, otherwise 0.

resetSettings.desc: Turns off the flash on the engine side then resets the Lua settings to default values.

restoreRuntimeState.desc: Turns off the flash on the engine side (util/photomodeFlash.enable(false)) if it is loaded, without touching the Lua settings.
